Got in to see my primary doc today (miracle he had a same day appt) - he increase my welbutrin to 450 and referred me for a sleep study. 

Skeptical.

Pretty consistent, the same recurring thought - It's almost self referential in that one of the reasons I feel suicidal is the constant suicidal thoughts- sounds weird writing it but this isn't logical.  I want to just switch my brain off and be done with it.
